news_summary: The Labor Department has suspended PERM labor-certification processing for Microsoft, Adobe and six large IT firms, halting a first step in employer-sponsored green-card cases while federal investigations proceed.
payoff: H-1B visas are not cancelled — affected workers face delay, not denial.
